rows.claim: Seal the measurement corpus with hashes and a timestamp BEFORE any test subject sees the battery, so post-seal drift is provable by re-hash.
rows.quote: freeze = record-level seal of the spine index; any post-seal estate change is detectable by re-hash. Corpus is frozen for this experiment from this timestamp.
rows.steal: Write a FREEZE_SEAL.json (sha256 of each spine file + frozen_at) before exposing any future battery or A/B; land it in watch/inbox/<experiment>/FREEZE_SEAL.json.
rows.falsifier: A seal whose hashes still match after the underlying files provably changed (size/mtime moved, sha256 identical), or a seal written after the test was scored. Tonight's re-hash found divergence, which SUPPORTS the organ.

rows.law: held-out ground truth is the anti-teaching-to-the-test organ
rows.claim: Keep verified answers in a separate file from the questions, written before exposure, so scoring cannot be gamed by training on the questions.
rows.quote: Every answer above was verified by reading the cited file/lines during this session; no answer is inferred from memory.
rows.steal: For every future evaluation, commit GROUND_TRUTH_HELDOUT.md in the same commit as BATTERY_HELDOUT.md but never ship it with the question set; land both under watch/inbox/<experiment>/.
rows.falsifier: Ground truth edited after candidate answers existed (git diff against commit 926b9abf1 would show it), or an answer slot with no cited file path to verify.

rows.claim: File a sheet of reference facts where every number was read or counted in-session and each fact carries its own exact re-verify command.
rows.quote: trust the counted number, not the prose.
rows.steal: Attach a control sheet section (fact + re-verify command) to every filed receipt that makes estate claims; land in the receipt file under watch/inbox/.
rows.falsifier: Any control-sheet fact that fails its own printed re-verify command when run fresh (e.g. stale row counts).

rows.law: method cards are transferable skill units
rows.claim: Compress a seat's working method into a numbered card of executable laws that a fresh session can run without the original operator.
rows.quote: How this seat turns an estate of ~1.2M files into answers. No luck involved.
rows.steal: After each hard-won capability lands, distill it into a CARD_V1.md of numbered laws (each law one executable rule with its bar) and land it beside the experiment it came from.
rows.falsifier: A fresh seat given only the card cannot execute the method (needs the original operator's tacit context to produce a valid receipt).

rows.claim: Any evaluation is itself a reusable battery: questions each answerable by a fact plus an exact path or number, sealed ground truth, and scored rows.
rows.quote: Each question is answerable with a fact plus an exact file path and/or number.
rows.steal: Run future gala lanes in this shape: battery file + sealed ground truth + lane JSON rows with byte-verified quotes; land in watch/inbox/gala_20260925/w3/lanes/.
rows.falsifier: A battery question whose answer needs no file path or number (pure recall or prose), making it ungradable by byte evidence.
